newsitem.title: USA: US Office receives $38.1 million investment.
newsitem.headline: US Office receives $38.1 million investment.

text.p: U.S. Office Products Co said Tuesday it has sold a $38.1 million direct equity investment to Quantam Partners LDC, an investment firm advised by Soros Fund Management in New York.
Quantum, based in the Cayman Islands, purchased 1.25 million new shares in U.S. Office Products. The transaction occurred last week.

Donald Platt, the company's chief financial officer, said in a statement that the 1.25 million share private placement will have a positive effect on its earnings since proceeds will be used initially to reduce debt.

On a pro forma basis, the reduction of debt by $38 million will save the company more than $3 million in annual interest, or nearly $0.04 a share, given about 41.5 million shares outstanding, Platt said in a statement.
U.S. Office Products Co supplies office products primarily to corporate, commercial and industrial customers.
